question: As per The Indian Tourism Statistics (ITS) 2020, which Indian state attracted the highest number of domestic tourists in the country in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• As per The Indian Tourism Statistics (ITS) 2020, **Uttar Pradesh**__ attracted the highest number of domestic tourists in 2019.
 
• Uttar Pradesh attracted **23.1%** of travellers visiting the state.
 
• According to the official reports, 53,58,55,162 domestic tourists visited the state in 2019.
 
• Around **53.6 crore** domestic tourists visited Uttar Pradesh in 2019.
 
• Uttar Pradesh bagged the third spot in terms of the arrival of** foreign tourists.**
 
• The foreign tourist arrival in India increased by** 2.2 % **in 2019.
 
• Uttar Pradesh also secured the third position in attracting foreign tourists with a record footfall of nearly** 47 lakh foreigners visiting in 2019.**
